content.text: {"title":"Rolling out the catalogue cache, twice","situation":{"text":"At Example Shop, the product pages were slow during sales, and we wanted a cache in front of the catalogue service.","quotes":["The product pages were slow during sales, and we wanted a cache in front of the catalogue service."]},"task":{"text":"I designed and rolled out the cache for the product catalogue.","quotes":["I designed and rolled out the cache."]},"action":{"text":"I rolled it out to all traffic at once on a Friday. Prices changed during a sale and the cache kept serving old prices for about an hour before I turned it off. Afterwards I added a way to clear the cache when a price changes, and rolled it out again one region at a time.","quotes":["I rolled it out to all traffic at once on a Friday.","Prices changed during a sale and the cache kept serving old prices for about an hour before I turned it off.","Afterwards I added a way to clear the cache when a price changes and rolled it out again one region at a time."]},"result":{"text":"The second rollout worked and the pages got faster. The bigger change was me: I don't ship big changes to all traffic at once anymore.","quotes":["The second rollout worked and the pages got faster.","The bigger change was me: I don't ship big changes to all traffic at once anymore."]},"atomIds":["5a0e8f3c-0000-4000-8000-000000000006"],"competencies":["failure","learning","ownership"],"followUps":[]}
